and report.
Alonso, do you have an update on the status of the Woodworks LLC shipment from Australia?
We need to deliver their timber and building materials by October 10th.
Are we going to meet the deadline?
I think so, but we probably shouldn't ship that timber to the port we typically use.
The average wait time at the port is 53 hours.
It's too long.
Well, that was last week.
So, before we make any changes, we should follow up with the Port Authority Director.
Thank you.

和报告。
Alonso，你有没有关于来自澳大利亚的 Woodworks LLC 货物的最新情况？
我们需要在 10 月 10 日之前运送他们的木材和建筑材料。
我们能赶上这个期限吗？
我想可以，但我们可能不应该把那批木材运到我们通常使用的港口。
港口的平均等待时间是 53 小时。
太久了。
嗯，那是上周的事了。
所以，在我们做任何改变之前，我们应该跟进一下港务局主任。
